in_sanskrit.name: Sinu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon, Sinuous
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sinu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sinu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sita', which means 'Moon'. It is also derived from the Tamil and Telugu word 'Sinu', which means 'Sinuous'. This name is associated with the calmness, gentleness and flexibility of the moon and its sinuous movements.
